$description: Moshi Shape v0.1 light elevation. Two subtle opt-in shadow roles; flat surfaces are the default. Geometry uses approved numeric spacing primitives and existing Moshi color alpha primitives.

$extensions.moshi.rendering: Platform adapters implement the same intended visual hierarchy; iOS/Android shadow APIs differ from CSS and require representative application verification.

level1.$description: Optional subtle shadow for small floating surfaces, after appropriate tone/border differentiation.

level2.$description: Optional stronger but restrained shadow for dialogs or prominent floating surfaces; do not layer multiple elevation presets.
